landing-page.label: What's the main action you want visitors to take, and who is the page for?
landing-page.placeholder: e.g. book a demo for clinic managers

landing-page.label: What can't be missing on the page, and is there a reference you like?
landing-page.placeholder: e.g. testimonials, pricing and a site similar to brand X

web-app.label: Describe the main user flow, from start to finish.
web-app.placeholder: e.g. the customer logs in, creates an order and tracks its status

web-app.label: What types of users exist and what can each one do?
web-app.placeholder: e.g. admin manages everything, customer only sees their own data

mobile-app.label: What's the app's main feature and the problem it solves?
mobile-app.placeholder: e.g. log workouts and track the user's progress

mobile-app.label: Should it run on iOS, Android or both, and does it use device features?
mobile-app.placeholder: e.g. both, with camera and push notifications

e-commerce.label: What do you sell, how does it work today and what blocks you most?
e-commerce.placeholder: e.g. clothing, I sell on Instagram and lose orders to manual tracking

e-commerce.label: What does your store need that's different (shipping, subscription, wholesale, coupons)?
e-commerce.placeholder: e.g. shipping calculation, coupons and special wholesale pricing

api-backend.label: Which services or systems does this API need to connect and automate?
api-backend.placeholder: e.g. integrate ERP, payment gateway and send data to the CRM

api-backend.label: What data and traffic volume do you expect, and any known peaks?
api-backend.placeholder: e.g. 10k orders a day, peaking on Black Friday

contrato-pj.label: Which project or stack do you need reinforcement on, and what's the challenge?
contrato-pj.placeholder: e.g. React and Node, behind on delivering new screens

contrato-pj.label: What's the team and the way of working today (seniority, process, tools)?
contrato-pj.placeholder: e.g. three mid-level devs, two-week sprints on Jira

sistema-gestao.label: Which process is most manual or messy and costs you time?
sistema-gestao.placeholder: e.g. inventory control done across separate spreadsheets

sistema-gestao.label: What do you use today and what should this system unify or automate?
sistema-gestao.placeholder: e.g. spreadsheets and WhatsApp; I want everything in one panel

chatbots-ia.label: What task does the bot or AI need to solve and how is it done today?
chatbots-ia.placeholder: e.g. answer customer questions that today go to email

chatbots-ia.label: Where does the knowledge or data come from and on which channels will it run?
chatbots-ia.placeholder: e.g. PDF catalog and website, running on WhatsApp and the site

other.label: What's the project's goal and the problem you want to solve?
other.placeholder: e.g. digitize a process that today is all on paper

other.label: Any reference, deadline or constraint we should know about?
other.placeholder: e.g. something similar to app X, ready by December
